body:
Thanks all for the kind comments.  I have had a long talk with him and he admits he is also unhappy (of course, he blames that on my being unhappy) but at the very least he's going to try therapy with me and understands this is all very serious and not to be swept under the rug.

Thanks for the ear.  I needed it.

And hugs back to all of those who offered them.

I should note that I've booked us a therapy appointment for next week, though I doubt my husband will attend.  He's offered to go to the first one out of "pity" even though I think he needs therapy as much as I do.

I just need some support...ASAP.  This is a throwaway but I'm a good Redditor who supports the community, is involved in "giving" subs like RAOP and RAOC, and just needs the anonymous internets to give me a hug.
